description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it, Mole Man, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Mole Man trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
